overview.description: The T-REX 2X Inverse CRCL Daily Target ETF (CRCD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide (-2x) inverse exposure to the daily price movement of Circle Internet Group, Inc. stock (NYSE: CRCL), less fees and expenses CRCD was launched on Sep 26, 2025 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
